report_metadata.report_title: MISRA C:2012 Compliance Report - Engine Core Module

summary.compliance_notes: No mandatory rule violations. Required rule violations require deviation documentation or remediation. Two critical logic bugs identified in diag.c require immediate attention.

violations.rule_text: Controlling expressions shall not be invariant
violations.message: CRITICAL LOGIC BUG: The expression '(DIAG_STRING)' is an enum constant (non-zero value), making the entire condition always evaluate to true. The negation makes the if-block unreachable. This bypasses the impact level validation entirely.

analysis.actual_behavior: DIAG_STRING is an enum constant with non-zero value. The expression (DIAG_STRING) always evaluates to true in boolean context. Therefore ((impact == DIAG_SYSTEM) || (DIAG_STRING)) is always true, and the negation is always false.
analysis.security_impact: HIGH - Invalid impact levels will not be detected, potentially causing diagnostic system to process malformed data
analysis.safety_impact: ASIL-relevant: Diagnostic subsystem handles safety-critical error reporting. Bypassing validation could lead to incorrect error handling.

violations.remediation_hint: Replace '(DIAG_STRING)' with '(impact == DIAG_STRING)' to properly validate the impact parameter

violations.rule_text: Controlling expressions shall not be invariant
violations.message: CRITICAL BUG - DEAD CODE: Variable 'checkfail' is initialized to 0 at line 213 and is never modified before this check at line 216. The condition will always be false, making DIAG_Reset() unreachable in this path.

analysis.code_between: No statements modify checkfail between declaration and check
analysis.intended_behavior: DIAG_Reset() should likely be called unconditionally, or checkfail should be set based on some validation
analysis.todo_comment: Line 215 has TODO comment: 'this will always evaluate to true?!' - indicating developer awareness of issue

violations.remediation_hint: Either call DIAG_Reset() unconditionally, or implement proper logic to set checkfail before the condition check. The TODO comment suggests the intent was to always execute DIAG_Reset().

violations.rule_text: The value returned by a function having non-void return type shall be used
violations.message: Return value of CANTX_SendFatalErrorId() is not used. The function may return status indicating transmission success or failure.

analysis.consequence: Failed CAN transmission for fatal error notification goes undetected

violations.remediation_hint: Check return value and handle transmission failures appropriately, or explicitly cast to (void) with documented justification

violations.rule_text: The value returned by a function having non-void return type shall be used
violations.message: Return value of CANTX_SendFatalErrorId() is not used when sending clear message.

analysis.consequence: Failed CAN transmission for error clear notification goes undetected

violations.remediation_hint: Check return value and handle transmission failures, or explicitly cast to (void) with justification

violations.rule_text: The value returned by a function having non-void return type shall be used
violations.message: Return value of CANTX_SendFatalErrorId() is not used in periodic resend loop.

analysis.context: Called in timer callback for periodic resend of fatal errors
analysis.consequence: Repeated transmission failures during resend cycle go undetected

violations.remediation_hint: Consider error counting or backoff strategy for repeated failures, or document (void) cast justification

violations.rule_text: The value returned by a function having non-void return type shall be used
violations.message: Return value of TIMER_Start() is not used. Timer start failure would leave fatal error resend mechanism inactive.

analysis.consequence: Failed timer start means fatal errors will not be periodically resent

violations.remediation_hint: Check return value and handle timer start failure, potentially falling back to immediate CAN transmission

violations.rule_text: The value returned by a function having non-void return type shall be used
violations.message: Return value of TIMER_Stop() is not used. Timer stop failure could leave unnecessary timer running.

analysis.consequence: Failed timer stop is a resource leak, timer continues running unnecessarily

violations.remediation_hint: Check return value and log timer stop failure for diagnostics

violations.rule_text: The value returned by a function having non-void return type shall be used
violations.message: Return value of FRAM_WriteData() is not used. FRAM write failure would lose system monitoring violation record.

analysis.context: Writing system monitoring violation records to non-volatile storage
analysis.consequence: Failed FRAM write loses safety-relevant timing violation data

violations.remediation_hint: Check return value and implement retry or error flagging mechanism

violations.rule_text: Both operands of an operator in which the usual arithmetic conversions are performed shall have the same essential type category
violations.message: Potential type mismatch: diagId is DIAG_ID_e (enum) divided by integer literal 32. Result assigned to uint16_t.

violations.rule_text: Both operands of an operator in which the usual arithmetic conversions are performed shall have the same essential type category
violations.message: Shift operation with signed integer: '1' is signed int. Left-shifting signed value can cause undefined behavior if high bit is set.

analysis.risk: If diagId % 32 == 31, shifting 1 left 31 positions sets the sign bit of a 32-bit int, which is implementation-defined

violations.rule_text: There shall be no dead code
violations.message: Empty function implementation - dead code. Function is declared but has no implementation.

analysis.usage: Function may be called but performs no operation

violations.remediation_hint: Implement the function or add documentation comment explaining the empty implementation

violations.rule_text: There shall be no dead code
violations.message: Empty function implementation - likely placeholder or stub.

analysis.usage: Appears to be intentional placeholder based on naming
analysis.intent: May be used for testing or as interface stub

violations.remediation_hint: Add documentation comment if intentional, or remove if truly unused

critical_bugs_detail.description: Two critical logic bugs were identified in diag.c that require immediate attention due to their impact on diagnostic system functionality.

bugs.title: Invalid Impact Level Validation - Logic Error
bugs.description: The condition at line 364 contains a logical error where 'DIAG_STRING' (an enum constant) is used instead of 'impact == DIAG_STRING'. Since DIAG_STRING is a non-zero enum value, it always evaluates to true in boolean context, making the entire validation check ineffective.
bugs.root_cause: Missing comparison operator - likely a copy-paste or typo error

impact_analysis.what_happens: Any impact value passed to DIAG_Handler() will be accepted, even invalid ones
impact_analysis.safety_concern: Invalid diagnostic events could be processed without proper error handling
impact_analysis.affected_callers: All modules calling DIAG_Handler() with potentially invalid impact levels

bugs.recommended_fix: Change line 364 to: if (!((impact == DIAG_SYSTEM) || (impact == DIAG_STRING))) {

bugs.title: Dead Code - DIAG_Reset Never Called
bugs.description: Variable 'checkfail' is initialized to 0 and never modified before the condition check at line 216. The condition 'checkfail > 0u' will always be false, making the call to DIAG_Reset() unreachable through this code path.
bugs.root_cause: Incomplete implementation - TODO comment at line 215 indicates developer awareness

code_context.line_215: /* TODO this will always evaluate to true?! */

impact_analysis.what_happens: DIAG_Reset() is not called during initialization
impact_analysis.note: DIAG_Reset() may be called through other paths, but this specific initialization path is dead
impact_analysis.safety_concern: Diagnostic counters may not be properly reset during initialization

bugs.recommended_fix: Either remove the condition and call DIAG_Reset() unconditionally, or implement proper logic to set checkfail based on initialization validation

immediate_actions.action: Fix logic bug at diag.c:364 - Add missing comparison operator
Fix dead code at diag.c:216 - Implement proper initialization logic
